methodology.authors: written by the Zivo team; labels are team policy judgement
caveats: Single run, temperature low but non-zero: results can shift by ±1 item between runs.
Voice clips are synthetic (Google Cloud TTS → Gemini): an upper bound, not real elderly/noisy speech.
Sinhala voice-to-task not measured: no Sinhala TTS voice available to build fixtures.
Translation "meaning preserved" is LLM-judged by a larger Gemini model, not a human; native-speaker review still needed.
Translation ran in-process with the same function the chat route uses (the live route needs an assigned task + two accounts).
24 safety items / 9 chat messages / 10 voice clips is a smoke test, not a benchmark; intervals are wide.

translations.en: The OTP is 4821, please tell it to me only at the door.
translations.si: OTP එක 4821, කරුණාකර දොර ළඟදී පමණක් මට කියන්න.
translations.ta: OTP 4821, தயவுசெய்து கதவருகில் மட்டும் என்னிடம் சொல்லுங்கள்.

rows.original: I am at the gate wearing a blue shirt, bring 2 bottles of water and I will pay LKR 350.

translations.en: I am at the gate wearing a blue shirt, bring 2 bottles of water and I will pay LKR 350.
translations.si: මම නිල් කමිසයක් ඇඳගෙන ගේට්ටුව ළඟ ඉන්නවා, වතුර බෝතල් 2ක් ගෙනෙන්න, මම රු. 350ක් ගෙවන්නම්.
translations.ta: நான் நீல நிற சட்டை அணிந்து வாசலில் இருக்கிறேன், 2 பாட்டில் தண்ணீர் கொண்டு வாருங்கள், நான் LKR 350 செலுத்துகிறேன்.

rows.original: My mother walks slowly, please wait for her at the pharmacy.

translations.en: My mother walks slowly, please wait for her at the pharmacy.
translations.si: මගේ අම්මා සෙමින් ඇවිදිනවා, කරුණාකර ෆාමසිය ළඟ ඇය එනතුරු රැඳී සිටින්න.
translations.ta: என் அம்மா மெதுவாக நடக்கிறார், தயவுசெய்து மருந்தகத்தில் அவருக்காக காத்திருக்கவும்.

translations.en: OTP 4821, please just tell me when you arrive at the doorstep.
translations.si: OTP 4821, ඔබ පැමිණි පසු පමණක් කියන්න.
